entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，全渠道的，全渠道零售，多触点一体
entries.en: The retailer invested in omnichannel inventory so online orders can ship from stores.

entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，最后一公里，末端配送，末端环节的

entries.zh: 无人机与快递柜正被试验用于降低末端配送费用。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，客流量，进店人次，人流

entries.zh: 简化支付表单后，两周内移动端转化率便有所提升。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，点击通过，点击率相关，点进

entries.zh: 新邮件主题行使点击通过率比上月翻了一番。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，展示次数，广告曝光，印象
entries.en: The campaign delivered two million impressions but few qualified leads.
entries.zh: 该活动带来了两百万次展示，但合格线索很少。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，互动，用户参与度，约定/聘用
entries.en: Short-form video posts drove higher engagement than static image ads.
entries.zh: 短视频帖子带来的互动高于静态图片广告。

entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，正常运行时间，可用时长，在线率

entries.zh: 服务级别协议要求营业时间内百分之九十九点九五的可用率。

entries.spelling: F, A, I, L, O, V, E, R
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，故障切换，故障转移，备用接管
entries.en: Automatic failover kept the checkout API available during the database outage.
entries.zh: 自动故障切换使结账 API 在数据库故障期间仍保持可用。

entries.spelling: C, A, P, E, X
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，资本性支出，固定资产投资，CapEx
entries.en: Building the new warehouse will require significant capex over two fiscal years.
entries.zh: 新建仓库需要在两个财年内投入大额资本性支出。

entries.spelling: O, P, E, X
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，运营支出，经营费用，OpEx
entries.en: Moving to the cloud converted some hardware capex into predictable monthly opex.
entries.zh: 上云把部分硬件资本支出转变成了可预期的月度运营支出。

entries.spelling: E, B, I, T, D, A
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，息税折旧摊销前利润，EBITDA
entries.en: Management guided full-year EBITDA to grow mid-teens despite higher logistics costs.
entries.zh: 尽管物流成本上升，管理层仍指引全年 EBITDA 将实现百分之十几的增长。

entries.spelling: W, R, I, T, E, hyphen, D, O, W, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或动词，减值，资产减记，下调账面价值
entries.en: Obsolete chip inventory forced a sizable write-down in the third quarter.
entries.zh: 过时芯片存货迫使公司在第三季度进行大额减记。

entries.spelling: L, E, A, D, hyphen, T, I, M, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，前置时间，交货周期，提前期
entries.en: Custom tooling has a twelve-week lead-time, so orders must be placed early.
entries.zh: 定制工装有十二周交货周期，因此必须提前下单。

entries.spelling: C, Y, C, L, E, hyphen, T, I, M, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，周期时间，单件加工周期，流程循环时长
entries.en: Automation cut average cycle-time on the packing line by almost 30 percent.
entries.zh: 自动化使包装线平均周期时间缩短了近百分之三十。

entries.spelling: B, R, I, C, K, hyphen, A, N, D, hyphen, M, O, R, T, A, R
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，实体店的，砖瓦门店，线下实体零售
entries.en: Even digital-first brands are opening brick-and-mortar stores for brand experience.
entries.zh: 即便数字优先品牌也在开设实体店以打造品牌体验。

entries.spelling: P, O, P, hyphen, U, P
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，快闪店，弹出式的，临时店铺
entries.en: The brand ran a two-week pop-up in the airport to test traveler demand.
entries.zh: 该品牌在机场开设为期两周的快闪店，以测试旅客需求。

entries.spelling: T, H, O, U, G, H, T, hyphen, L, E, A, D, E, R, S, H, I, P
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，思想领导力，观点引领，专业见解输出
entries.en: The white paper strengthened the firm's thought-leadership in sustainable logistics.
entries.zh: 该白皮书强化了公司在可持续物流领域的思想领导力。

entries.spelling: B, U, S, I, N, E, S, S, hyphen, C, O, N, T, I, N, U, I, T, Y
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，业务连续性，持续经营能力，灾备持续运营
entries.en: The audit found gaps in the company's business-continuity plan for regional outages.
entries.zh: 审计发现公司针对区域中断的业务连续性计划存在缺口。

entries.spelling: A, M, E, N, D, M, E, N, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，修正案，修订条款，合同变更
entries.en: Please review the amendment before we circulate the revised agreement.
entries.zh: 请在我们分发修订协议前审阅该修正案。

entries.spelling: A, L, L, E, G, A, T, I, O, N
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，指控，指称，未经证实的说法
entries.en: The compliance team opened a review after several allegations of kickbacks.
entries.zh: 在出现多起回扣指控后，合规团队启动了审查。

entries.spelling: F, I, N, E, hyphen, P, R, I, N, T
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，小字条款，细则，附属条件
entries.en: The cancellation fee was buried in the fine print of the vendor contract.
entries.zh: 取消费用被写在供应商合同的小字条款里。

entries.spelling: H, O, L, D, hyphen, H, A, R, M, L, E, S, S
entries.spoken_meaning: 形容词或名词，免责的，免责条款，使不受损害
entries.en: Facilities will not admit contractors without a signed hold-harmless agreement.
entries.zh: 设施部门在未签署免责协议前不会允许承包商进场。

entries.spelling: N, O, N, hyphen, C, O, M, P, E, T, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，竞业禁止，竞业限制协议，禁止同业竞争的
entries.en: Her offer letter includes a 12-month non-compete covering the regional market.
entries.zh: 她的录用通知书含有覆盖区域市场的十二个月竞业禁止条款。

entries.spelling: P, A, P, E, R, hyphen, T, R, A, I, L
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，书面记录链，可追溯文件，证据链条

entries.zh: 审计人员要求提供每笔采购订单审批的完整书面记录链。

entries.spelling: Z, E, R, O, hyphen, T, O, L, E, R, A, N, C, E
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词或形容词，零容忍，零容忍政策，绝不姑息
entries.en: The plant has a zero-tolerance policy for working without a hard hat.
entries.zh: 该工厂对未戴安全帽作业实行零容忍政策。

entries.spelling: C, O, N, T, I, N, G, E, N, C, Y
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，应急预案，偶然事件，或有事项
entries.en: We set aside five percent of the project cost as a contingency.
entries.zh: 我们预留了项目成本的百分之五作为应急金。

entries.spelling: C, O, U, N, T, E, R, P, A, R, T, Y
entries.spoken_meaning: 名词，交易对手，合同相对方，对手方
entries.en: Treasury reviews the credit rating of each new counterparty before settlement.
entries.zh: 资金部在结算前会审核每位新交易对手的信用评级。

entries.spelling: F, I, D, U, C, I, A, R, Y

entries.zh: 董事会成员必须以全体股东的受托人身份行事。
